# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

ZeroLabz prioritizes the security of our P2P mesh networking, zero-trust Auto-Heal triggers, and ML-DSA/ML-KEM lattice integrations within the QuantumEdge architecture.

If you identify a vulnerability—especially concerning P2P DataChannel leaks, prompt injection in the AI Studio integration, or attestation bypasses—please do not disclose it publicly.

1. Email vulnerability details to **dev@zrolabz.com**.
2. Include reproduction steps, affected components, and potential attack vectors.
3. You will receive an initial response within 48 hours acknowledging receipt and next steps.
